title: Passage 4  A Rainy Sunday
subtitle: 考点：现在进行时
passage: It is Sunday today. It is raining heavily, so we aren't going out. My father is reading a newspaper in the living room, and my mother is cooking lunch in the kitchen.

My little brother Tom is playing with our dog, Coco. Coco is running around the sofa and Tom is laughing loudly. I am sitting at my desk and writing this passage. I like rainy days, but I like sunny days better.
vocab: heavily（雨）大地 · newspaper 报纸 · living room 客厅 · laugh 笑 · sofa 沙发 · desk 书桌

questions.stem: What is the weather like today?
questions.why: 原文：It is raining heavily.

questions.stem: Where is the father?
questions.why: 原文：My father is reading a newspaper in the living room. 厨房里的是妈妈。

questions.stem: Who is playing with Coco?
questions.why: 原文：My little brother Tom is playing with our dog, Coco.

questions.stem: What is the writer doing?
questions.why: 原文：I am sitting at my desk and writing this passage.

sections.title: 二、判断正误（对选 T，错选 F）

questions.stem: Today is Saturday.
questions.why: 原文：It is Sunday today.

questions.stem: The family is going out today.
questions.why: 原文：we aren't going out（不出门）。

questions.stem: Coco is running around the sofa.
questions.why: 原文：Coco is running around the sofa.

questions.stem: The writer likes sunny days better than rainy days.
questions.why: 原文：I like rainy days, but I like sunny days better.

sections.title: 三、选词填空（每词限用一次）

questions.stem: It is raining heavily, ____ we aren't going out.
questions.why: 前面是原因（下大雨），后面是结果（不出门），用 so。

questions.stem: My father is reading a newspaper ____ the living room.
questions.why: in the living room 在客厅里。

questions.stem: My father is reading, ____ my mother is cooking lunch.
questions.why: 并列两件同时进行的事，用 and。

questions.stem: Tom is playing ____ the dog.
questions.why: play with sb./sth. 和…玩。

questions.stem: Coco is running ____ the sofa.
questions.why: run around the sofa 绕着沙发跑。

questions.stem: I am sitting ____ my desk.
questions.why: at my desk 在书桌旁。

questions.stem: I like rainy days, ____ I like sunny days better.
questions.why: 前后转折，用 but。

sections.title: 四、用动词的适当形式填空

questions.stem: Look! The children ____ in the playground.
questions.why: Look! 提示动作正在进行，用现在进行时 be + doing；children 是复数，用 are playing。

questions.stem: Be quiet! The baby ____ now.
questions.why: now 提示正在进行；The baby 是单数，用 is sleeping。

questions.stem: My mother ____ dinner in the kitchen now.
questions.why: now 提示正在进行；My mother 是单数，用 is cooking。

questions.stem: What are you ____ now?
questions.why: are you … now? 是现在进行时，do 要用 doing。
questions.hint: 用 do 的正确形式

questions.stem: Listen! Someone ____ in the music room.
questions.why: Listen! 提示正在进行；Someone 是单数，用 is singing。

questions.stem: They ____ an English book at the moment.
questions.why: at the moment 此刻，用现在进行时；They 是复数，用 are reading。
